guard: A fanOut branch that rejects fails the scope with its own value, cancels its siblings, and the losers travel with the failure, exactly as a failed parallel. (FAIL-FAST suite: markers are upstream of the cells they guard.)

mutations.name: the siblings are not cancelled on a branch's rejection (the old behaviour)
mutations.expectRed: and the siblings are cancelled: a branch whose effect completes after the failure begins no new effect
mutations.completionMarker: ok a rejecting fanOut branch fails the scope with the branch's own thrown value, which the program can catch
mutations.cell: and the siblings are cancelled: a branch whose effect completes after the failure begins no new effect
mutations.note: Measured before the rule: every sibling went on performing effects against a scope whose entry had settled failed.

mutations.name: the failed scope forgets its losers
mutations.expectRed: and the failed scope entry records the losers as intent, like a failed parallel
mutations.completionMarker: ok and the siblings are cancelled: a branch whose effect completes after the failure begins no new effect
mutations.cell: and the failed scope entry records the losers as intent, like a failed parallel
